content.short: Ostium is a decentralized perpetuals exchange on Arbitrum focused on Real World Assets (RWAs).
content.description: Ostium is a high-performance decentralized exchange that specializes in the trading of synthetic perpetual futures for traditional assets. Built on Arbitrum, Ostium enables users to gain leveraged exposure to a wide array of Real World Assets—including gold, oil, forex pairs, and global equities—directly from their crypto wallets. The protocol focuses on providing a transparent, non-custodial trading experience with deep liquidity and high leverage, settled entirely in stablecoins. Ostium aims to bring the transparency and efficiency of DeFi to the massive global commodities and forex markets.
